title: Hastings Spa

services.name: Massage
services.desc: Looking for the best body massage in Vancouver? At Hastings Spa, we simplify the choice by offering a fusion body massage Vancouver style, that combines Acupressure, Deep Tissue, and Swedish techniques-tailored to your body’s unique needs. Experience deeper relaxation, muscle relief, and energy balance all in one session. Acupressure is rooted in Traditional Chinese Medicine and uses targeted pressure to stimulate energy meridians in the body. It is ideal for people seeking a natural alternative to pain medication. Our trained therapists apply pressure with thumbs, knuckles, or fingers in intervals of 30 seconds to 2 minutes, helping your body release tension and restore energy flow. Read

Combo your massage with a hybrid infrared sauna

services.name: Private Event Booking
services.desc: Celebrate in comfort at Hastings Spa. Whether you’re planning a bachelorette, birthday party, bridal shower, or corporate event, we offer two ways to relax together - Group Booking (Private Sauna Access) and Private Event Booking (Full Spa Rental). Both options include dedicated massage and sauna service time, and each requires a minimum charge equal to at least one 50-minute massage session per guest. Perfect for groups of 4-8 guests who wish to enjoy massages together while having private access to their own sauna area. For guests who want a completely private experience, our Private Booking reserves the entire spa level - including both saunas, foot lounge, and all massage rooms

services.name: Cold Plunge
services.desc: The practice of alternating between a hot sauna and a cold plunge is not new. It has been done for centuries in various cultures, particularly in Nordic countries, as a ritual for relaxation and rejuvenation. It comes with benefits and risks that are not always readily apparent or worth it for everyone. Hastings Spa chooses not to offer cold plunge at this time until there is more advancement in reducing the risks versus the proven safety of cold showers to achieve a more controlled cooling. So, let’s explore the pros and cons. The combination of sauna and cold plunge offers a range of potential health benefits, including improved circulation, reduced inflammation, and enhanced recovery.

explain.meaning: A short dip in very cold water, often after a sauna.
